d: Role Description The HR Coordinator at Asociación Be Human is a part-time, remote role responsible for supporting daily human resources operations and ensuring a positive experience for team members. The position involves assisting with HR administration, maintaining employee records, and coordinating onboarding and offboarding processes. The HR Coordinator will help implement HR policies, support benefits administration tasks, and respond to employee inquiries with a focus on clear communication and confidentiality. The role also includes monitoring compliance with organizational guidelines, supporting employee relations initiatives, and collaborating with leadership to maintain a healthy, inclusive work culture.
q: Candidates should possess skills in HR Management and Human Resources (HR) to support daily HR operations and processes.
Candidates should possess skills in Benefits Administration to assist with enrollment, documentation, and basic employee benefit inquiries.
Candidates should possess skills in Employee Relations to help address concerns, support conflict resolution, and promote a respectful work environment.
Candidates should possess skills in HR Policies to help implement, communicate, and maintain organizational guidelines and procedures.
Strong organizational, time management, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to handle confidential information responsibly.
Effective written and verbal communication skills in en_US, and comfort working with remote teams and digital collaboration tools.
Previous experience in an HR support or coordination role is preferred; familiarity with nonprofit or mission-driven organizations is an advantage.
Relevant education in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
